header: The band that opens a price list
subheader: An eyebrow, a title, a standfirst and one line of small print — and deliberately not a single number.
lead: The header sets the frame the plans below sit in: who the prices are for, what they cover, and on what terms. Everything that applies to the whole page belongs here rather than on each card.
note: Currency, tax and billing terms go in the note, where they are stated once instead of on every price.
